dogecoin.text: Why do I feel like @elonmusk made a grave mistake last night. By calling @dogecoin a hustle it hurt any chance of this becoming a legitimate currency. Was it on purpose or did the network that it aired on have something to do with it? Either way I’m pissed.

There’s a lot of things you can do in life that will make you a better person. You could have good morals and know right from wrong. You could be a bookworm and discover the next way to view our universe in a whole. Me, I’ve done all of that and one thing comes to mind #dogecoin
